record.question: Why are gas turbines frequently used in power grids for "peaking" applications?
options: They have high capital costs but run efficiently at baseloads
They take hours to synchronize with the power grid
They have fast start-up times and can quickly meet peak electricity demands
They do not require a compressor to operate
